text.arabic_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect deployment of the prior wind as a compelled instrument over a hostile target
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes ridicule, service, and subjection; the local Form II clause selects managed subjugation and punitive deployment
words.prose: {{ar:سَخَّرَهَا}} ({{tr:sakhkharahā}}) opens by importing the wind from the previous ayah through its feminine object suffix. The Form II stem makes that wind a managed, compelled instrument, while the unnamed subject lets the event surge forward as deployment rather than explanation. The word therefore turns a broader {{ar:س خ ر}} ({{tr:s-kh-r}}) field, known elsewhere for cosmic subjugation toward benefit, into hostile punishment here.

topics.headline: prior wind carried by suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wind from the previous ayah is not renamed but is carried into the new action by the feminine object suffix.
topics.reason: The object suffix on {{ar:سَخَّرَهَا}} ({{tr:sakhkharahā}}) is syntactically forced and the cross-reference resolves it to the prior wind.

topics.headline: managed subjugation, not mockery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root range is narrowed to managed compulsion: a natural force is made to serve punishment rather than the mockery branch.
topics.reason: Form II and the object suffix select compelled deployment of the wind; the mockery branch of {{ar:س خ ر}} ({{tr:s-kh-r}}) remains a root-family contrast, not the local sense.

topics.headline: implicit agency launches the event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from the prior description of the wind into an event sequence without pausing to rename the divine agent.
topics.reason: The perfect Form II verb opens the clause with no explicit subject, and the local syntax makes it the head of the deployment-and-duration frame.

topics.headline: benefit formula turned hostile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar cosmic-subjugation pattern elsewhere tied to benefit is turned here toward hostile punishment.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows contrast benefactive cosmic subjugation at (14:33) and (16:12) with the hostile local construction.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus plural suffix marking the hostile target of the deployed wind
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) makes the deployment adversative. The force is directed upon them as pressure against a target, not offered for them as benefit. Its plural suffix also completes the cross-ayah chain: the prior people are picked up here just as the prior wind was picked up by the opening object suffix.

topics.headline: upon becomes against
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wind is not merely located above them; the preposition routes the deployed force against them.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement is governed by {{ar:سَخَّرَهَا}} ({{tr:sakhkharahā}}), so {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) functions as adversative targeting rather than neutral location.

topics.headline: target pronoun resumes the prior people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the victims are not newly introduced; the plural suffix resumes the people from the previous ayah while the wind is resumed by the prior suffix.
topics.reason: The cross-reference evidence resolves the masculine plural suffix to the people already introduced, creating a paired boundary link with the wind suffix.

words.gloss_range: accusative cardinal numeral measuring the first part of the duration
words.root_gloss_range: number root used locally as exact seven, with completeness pressure retained but not replacing the count
words.prose: {{ar:سَبْعَ}} ({{tr:sabʿa}}) is an accusative time measure, so the punishment is given a counted duration rather than a vague span. Its seven count carries complete-cycle pressure, but that pressure sits inside an exact cardinal construction. Because the nights come first, this count makes darkness the first frame before the asymmetrical eight-day measure arrives. The same number root also returns at (69:32), so the count functions as a small surah-local numerical marker as well as a duration measure.

topics.headline: exact temporal count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that seven is not just a number label but an accusative time measure for how long the imposed wind remains operative.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence read the numeral as an accusative temporal adverbial governed by the deployment clause.

topics.headline: seven as complete cycle pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both exact counting and complete-cycle pressure in the seven-night measure.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply symbolic completeness while the grammar keeps the local value an exact cardinal count.

topics.headline: nights counted before days
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the duration begins with darkness and then expands into the marked seven-eight pair.
topics.reason: The local order places the night count first and coordinates it with the following day count.

topics.headline: local numerical recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same number root later recurs in the surah, making number a small structural marker as well as a duration count.
topics.reason: The recurrence row explicitly links this root to the later local-surah occurrence at (69:32).

words.gloss_range: genitive indefinite broken plural naming the seven counted nights
words.root_gloss_range: night root locally denotes dark intervals; derivational debate is noted without changing the referent
words.prose: {{ar:لَيَالٍ}} ({{tr:layālin}}) supplies the unit counted by seven: exact in number, indefinite in calendar identity. The word keeps the punishment inside repeated dark intervals, which the later seeing scene will answer with exposed visibility. Its marked broken plural and root discussion remain philological pressure, but the local sense is simply the nights in the counted span. Because the night unit is counted before the day unit, a familiar night-day pairing becomes a punishment calendar rather than a loose temporal formula.

topics.headline: counted but unspecified nights
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the nights are exactly numbered but not made into a named calendar block.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the construct numeral and indefinite, so it supplies the counted unit without definiteness.

topics.headline: dark intervals before sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dark intervals prepare a later contrast with direct seeing.
topics.reason: The local sequence moves from nights to the later perception verb, giving night a visibility payoff inside the ayah.

topics.headline: marked plural with root debate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a morphologically marked plural and a live derivational question, while the local referent remains ordinary nights.
topics.reason: The rows preserve the {{ar:ل ي ل}} ({{tr:l-y-l}}) versus {{ar:ل و ل}} ({{tr:l-w-l}}) derivational pressure, but QAC and context keep the local sense as nights.

topics.headline: familiar polarity specialized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar night-day pairing is specialized into a punishment calendar by being counted before days.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows support the temporal pair, while the local wording uses counted nights and days rather than a loose polarity formula.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the second time measure to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) links the day-count to the night-count as accumulated duration. It prevents the second phrase from collapsing into a restatement and gives the long temporal measure a small cadence hinge before the second numeral enters.

topics.headline: two time blocks joined
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the seven nights and eight days are accumulated into one duration rather than treated as appositional restatements.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second numeral as coordinated with the first, and the CRITICAL rows distinguish this connector from the later result marker.

topics.headline: short hinge between long counts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the brief audible hinge that separates and binds the two long duration phrases.
topics.reason: The single-letter conjunction sits between two larger numeral phrases, giving a real recitational boundary.

words.gloss_range: accusative cardinal numeral measuring the second part of the duration
words.root_gloss_range: local branch is the number eight; valuation or price branches remain only background contrast
words.prose: {{ar:ثَمَٰنِيَةَ}} ({{tr:thamāniyata}}) mirrors the earlier count as another accusative time measure, but it does not simply balance it. Eight days against seven nights creates an asymmetrical duration, stretching the punishment beyond an even alternation. The root-family price field is not active locally; this is the numeral branch, with a later surah contrast when eight reappears at (69:17).

topics.headline: second accusative time count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the eight-day phrase has the same temporal status as the seven-night phrase.
topics.reason: The numeral is accusative, conjoined to the first count, and governs the following genitive day plural.

topics.headline: eight exceeds seven
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the duration is asymmetrical: eight days over against seven nights, not a flat day-night pair.
topics.reason: The row evidence makes the seven-eight pairing structurally meaningful, and the local grammar keeps both as coordinated time measures.

topics.headline: number branch selected over valuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root family includes valuation language, while this local form is strictly the numeral eight.
topics.reason: QAC tags {{ar:ثَمَٰنِيَةَ}} ({{tr:thamāniyata}}) as a numeral; price or valuation associations are root-family background, not the local branch.

topics.headline: later eight has another function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that eight returns later in the surah with a different cosmic role at (69:17), contrasting duration here with bearer-count there.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows explicitly compare the eight days of (69:7) with the later eight at (69:17).

words.gloss_range: genitive indefinite broken plural naming the eight counted day-periods
words.root_gloss_range: day root locally denotes counted days within duration, with broader period and intervention-time associations qualified by context
words.prose: {{ar:أَيَّامٍ}} ({{tr:ayyāmin}}) gives the unit governed by the eight-count. The word is indefinite and plural, so the span is precisely measured but not calendrically named. Its range leans toward day-periods in an extended duration rather than daylight alone, and that period sense lets the punishment participate in a wider intervention-time field without displacing the local count. The day-root also bridges this historical punishment span to the later judgment scene at (69:17), where day-language frames the cosmic aftermath.

topics.headline: days specify the eight count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the days are the governed unit of the eight-count, exact in number but unspecified as named dates.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the numeral and indefinite, so it specifies the counted duration without calendrical definiteness.

topics.headline: period-days, not daylight term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names day-periods in an extended duration, not merely daylight as opposed to night.
topics.reason: The local pairing with nights keeps day-night contrast visible, while the chosen word supports duration or period rather than the daylight term alone.

topics.headline: punishment time in a judgment field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counted days sit inside a broader Quranic field of intervention and judgment time.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows connect the day root with intervention-time formulas at (14:5) and (45:14), while local grammar keeps the ayah on the eight-day duration.

topics.headline: day count joins scene vocabulary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the day-count participates in the surah-local movement from measured destruction toward the later cosmic scene at (69:17).
topics.reason: The row evidence links the day root to seeing, people, and the later surah contrast, without changing the local counted sense.

words.gloss_range: accusative modifier of the duration, carrying continuity, severance, and finality
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes cutting off, deciding, and cauterizing; locally it qualifies the whole wind-duration as successive and severing
words.prose: {{ar:حُسُومًا}} ({{tr:ḥusūman}}) seals the duration phrase after both counts. Its accusative shape lets it range over the whole period as manner or specification: the wind operates continuously and decisively, not in scattered bursts. The root's cutting and cauterizing field makes the span feel like severance brought to finality. The local abstract form names the process-quality of severing continuity, while the variant reading intensifies the same destructive field without replacing the canonical parse; the hapax rarity and breath-to-hiss-to-closure sound profile concentrate that closure before the ayah turns to sight.

topics.headline: modifier ranges over the whole span
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final duration word can describe the whole span as manner, specification, or descriptive accusative.
topics.reason: The accusative form is licensed as a modifier of the deployment duration, with multiple close grammatical analyses preserved.

topics.headline: continuous cutting finality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the duration is not only long but unbroken and severing, like a process that cuts off life decisively.
topics.reason: The root rows preserve both continuity and cutting or cauterizing finality, and attachment places the word over the duration phrase.

topics.headline: process noun with variant intensity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a process-like abstract form locally, while the variant intensity reading remains an apparatus contrast.
topics.reason: The local QAC form is an abstract accusative noun; the variant intensifies the same semantic area without controlling the canonical parse.

topics.headline: duration phrase sealed before sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah completing deployment and duration before pivoting into the visible aftermath.
topics.reason: The word closes the first clause section before the result clause begins.

topics.headline: rare word with cutting sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a rare word with a breath-sibilant-close sound shape concentrates the unrepeatable severity of the duration.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify root-hapax rarity and a sound profile that suits the severing closure, without making sound the primary sense.

words.gloss_range: resultative proclitic introducing the visible consequence
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) is the hinge from imposed duration to consequence. It is stronger than a loose then: the following sight is the result of what the wind has done. Because the particle is fused to the seeing verb, the pivot into perception is immediate, contrasting with the earlier coordinating particle that only accumulated the time blocks.

topics.headline: result, not loose continuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sight scene is the consequence of the imposed duration, not just the next item in a list.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the following clause as resultative, and the CRITICAL rows distinguish the connector from loose continuation.

topics.headline: fused pivot into seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the small proclitic fuses consequence directly to the perception verb, rapidly shifting from action to witnessed aftermath.
topics.reason: The connector is attached to the seeing verb and introduces the result clause after the duration frame.

topics.headline: coordination versus consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between the earlier connector that accumulates duration and this connector that triggers aftermath.
topics.reason: The earlier {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) coordinates the time blocks, while {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) marks the move into result and address.

words.gloss_range: imperfect seeing verb opening the result scene to direct witness
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers seeing, perceiving, and judging; locally visual sight is primary with judgment pressure retained
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَى}} ({{tr:tarā}}) shifts the ayah from narrated deployment into witnessed aftermath. The form is morphologically open in isolation, but here it functions as a direct witness-position: the reader is made to see the people after the wind. Its imperfect aspect keeps the scene present, and the seeing root allows recognition or judgment to ride on the visual act, especially as the next ayah answers it at (69:8).

topics.headline: open person form assigns witness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse opening into a witness position, even though the form also admits a third-feminine parse in isolation.
topics.reason: QAC notes the formal ambiguity, while the discourse rows support the direct-address witness effect in context.

topics.headline: present seeing after past deployment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a completed deployment is followed by an imperfect verb that keeps the aftermath visually present.
topics.reason: The sequence moves from perfect deployment to imperfect perception in the result clause.

topics.headline: seeing as perception and judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that seeing the aftermath is also a way of recognizing or judging what the destruction means.
topics.reason: The root evidence allows visual perception and cognitive judgment, and the local aftermath scene supports both without replacing sight.

topics.headline: seeing answered at (69:8)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this seeing is immediately answered by the next ayah's challenge at (69:8).
topics.reason: The recurrence rows explicitly link the current seeing verb to the following ayah.

words.gloss_range: definite collective direct object of the seeing verb
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes standing and rising; locally the known collective is presented precisely as overturned into fallenness
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-qawma}}) is the definite object of seeing: the already-known people come into view as a social body before their state is named. The collective singular can later be resumed by a plural pronoun, because the individuals inside the group are active in the scene. The root's standing field sharpens the irony: the group named through standing is immediately displayed as felled, and the next ayah asks whether any remnant of them can be seen at (69:8).

topics.headline: known people as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the visible object is the already-known people as a social body, not anonymous bodies first named by collapse.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and accusative as the object of the seeing verb, and context identifies the group already in view.

topics.headline: singular collective licenses plural pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how a singular collective noun can later be picked up by a plural pronoun because the people inside the collective are foregrounded.
topics.reason: The later pronoun evidence resumes this collective by meaning rather than by surface singular morphology.

topics.headline: standing name inverted by fallen state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that a word from the standing field is immediately shown in a fallen state.
topics.reason: The {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) family supplies standing pressure, while the following state word presents the group as felled.

topics.headline: object before state, then remnant test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first shows the known people, then delays the collapse predicate, and the next ayah tests whether any remnant remains at (69:8).
topics.reason: The local syntax places the object before its state, and boundary rows connect this seen collective to the remnant challenge in the following ayah.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus feminine suffix locating the fallen people within the destructive setting
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) inserts a containing frame before the fallen-state word. Its feminine suffix is deliberately not pinned to only one antecedent: it can point to the measured period, the wind, or the event setting. That ambiguity lets the bodies be seen within the destructive time and medium at once, with containment shading toward immersion rather than neutral location alone.

topics.headline: feminine suffix reopens antecedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the feminine suffix can point to the duration, the wind, or the event setting, so the wording keeps the destructive medium and time frame close.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the antecedent as ambiguous and instructs preserving that ambiguity rather than forcing one resolution.

topics.headline: in it locates the fallen state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fallen state is placed inside the destructive setting before the collapse word arrives.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase locates the state and interrupts the object and its state word.

topics.headline: location becomes immersion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that containment can feel like immersion in the wind or period, not just a neutral place marker.
topics.reason: The local phrase is spatial or temporal containment, and the CRITICAL rows preserve the immersion pressure without resolving the pronoun beyond the guardrail.

words.gloss_range: passive participial plural describing the people as felled in the result scene
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes felling, throwing down, wrestling, and involuntary collapse; locally it names collective felled casualties
words.prose: {{ar:صَرْعَىٰ}} ({{tr:ṣarʿā}}) gives the state in which the people are seen: felled, not acting. Its passive plural shape makes the collapse collective and received. The root's wrestling and involuntary-collapse field intensifies the bodily violence, while the local destruction scene keeps the sense on casualties thrown down. The word also collides with the preceding collective noun: the standing people are now the felled people. As a Quranic root hapax, it concentrates the violent image in this aftermath scene, and its marked sound onset lets the prior shrieking wind become visible in bodies thrown down.

topics.headline: fallen as seen state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fallen-ness is the state in which the people are seen, not an independent new action they perform.
topics.reason: Attachment reads the word as circumstantial state, while QAC marks a passive participial plural.

topics.headline: violent bodily felling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a bodily, involuntary collapse pressure, while local grammar keeps the sense on felled casualties rather than a medical episode or sports scene.
topics.reason: The wrestling and seizure associations intensify collapse, but the passive participial plural and destruction scene select being felled.

topics.headline: standers become felled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the semantic collision between the standing-people word and the felled-state word.
topics.reason: The local sequence places {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-qawma}}) before {{ar:صَرْعَىٰ}} ({{tr:ṣarʿā}}), making the standing field collapse into fallenness.

topics.headline: rare felled word answers the prior wind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare felled word concentrates the violent aftermath and lets the prior shrieking wind become visible in bodies thrown down.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows support root-hapax rarity and a boundary sound-image link with the previous wind description.

words.gloss_range: inna-class simile particle with plural pronoun carrying the people into the image
words.prose: {{ar:كَأَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:ka-annahum}}) turns sight into a structured comparison. The plural suffix resumes the collective people by meaning and carries them into the image before the predicate appears. Because the particle opens a full inna-class simile clause, the resemblance is forceful without becoming literal identity: the fallen humans are mapped onto palm remains as an interpretive image. The nasal resonance around the people-pronoun and the later palm phrase gives that grammatical mapping a small audible binding.

topics.headline: plural people carried into simile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural human target enters the simile before the palm-remnant predicate is named.
topics.reason: The suffix is the ism of the particle and resumes the collective people by meaning.

topics.headline: full assertive simile clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison is grammatically strong and clause-shaped, while still remaining comparison rather than literal identity.
topics.reason: The inna-class particle governs a pronoun and predicate, producing a full resemblance clause.

topics.headline: aftermath becomes botanical image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices perception turning into interpretation: human bodies are mapped onto a whole scene of palm remains.
topics.reason: The simile clause expands the seen state with the phrase that follows.

topics.headline: sound ties pronoun to palms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small sound binding between the people-pronoun and the palm image.
topics.reason: The phonetic row offers a local sound payoff, secondary to the grammatical simile.

words.gloss_range: plural construct predicate naming palm-trunk remnants in the simile
words.root_gloss_range: root range spans inability and rear or lower remainder; locally narrowed to palm-trunk bases with powerlessness pressure retained
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْجَازُ}} ({{tr:aʿjāzu}}) is the predicate of the simile and also the construct head that binds the image to palms. Its broader rear-part or remainder range is narrowed by the following palm noun to trunk-bases, but the incapacity field of {{ar:ع ج ز}} ({{tr:ʿ-j-z}}) still makes the remains feel powerless, stripped of functional height. The broken plural gives the image a bulky scattered plurality, and the phrase recalls the same destruction formula at (54:20), where the angle is uprooting rather than hollowness.

topics.headline: predicate and construct head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word both reclassifies the people in the simile and binds the image to palms.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the word the predicate of the simile particle and the construct head governing the following genitive.

topics.headline: rear remainder narrowed to palm bases
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices lower, powerless remnancy made physical as palm-trunk bases, while the following palm noun narrows broader rear-part senses.
topics.reason: The following genitive selects the trunk or base sense while root-family incapacity remains a meaningful color.

topics.headline: weighty remnant plurality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scattered, bulky plurality of trunk-remnants; the variant plural pattern changes morphology without changing the image.
topics.reason: The word is a broken plural in the local form, and the variant row preserves a morphology contrast with the same referent.

topics.headline: specialized palm-trunk formula at (54:20)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the trunk-remnant phrase is a specialized destruction image for the same people, echoed at (54:20).
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows explicitly connect the phrase to (54:20), where uprooting is stressed while this ayah adds hollowness.

words.gloss_range: indefinite collective genitive specifying the palm source image
words.root_gloss_range: root locally names date-palms as a collective class; productive palm associations are inverted into stripped remains
words.prose: {{ar:نَخْلٍ}} ({{tr:nakhlin}}) specifies what kind of remnants the simile means: palm-trunks, not generic wood. As an indefinite collective, it evokes a class or field of palms rather than counted individual trees. That matters because the familiar productive palm image is stripped down to lower remains, and the same palm-trunk destruction formula is echoed at (54:20).

topics.headline: palm genitive specifies the trunks
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the remains are specifically palm-trunks, either as parts of palms or as a descriptive compound image.

topics.headline: collective palm category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a massed category of palm-remnants rather than individually counted trees.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite collective noun rather than a unit noun, and the variant collective form supports category-level palm reference.

topics.headline: fruitful palm stripped to ruin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a provision image inverted into stripped lower remains, with the fruit-bearing crown absent.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows contrast productive palm contexts with the local stripped-remnant simile.

topics.headline: rare image echoed at (54:20)
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the palm noun is part of the rare same-people destruction image also found at (54:20).
topics.reason: The recurrence rows explicitly connect the palm-trunk simile in this ayah with (54:20).

words.gloss_range: genitive feminine active participle describing the palm image as hollow or emptied
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes emptiness, vacancy, and collapsed ruin; locally narrowed to hollow palm interiors with ruin overtones
words.prose: {{ar:خَاوِيَةٍ}} ({{tr:khāwiyatin}}) is the ayah's last word, and it seals the simile on hollowness. Grammatically it locks onto the palm image, whether heard through the collective palm noun or the trunk-remnants themselves, and its feminine singular participle can characterize the whole non-rational collective field of remains. The active participle makes hollowness a settled condition rather than a momentary event. The wider ruin range of {{ar:خ و ي}} ({{tr:kh-w-y}}) is narrowed here to hollow interiors, but the collapsed-structure overtones remain. After imposed force at the opening, the ending leaves only an emptied shell; its open, airy sound profile and rarity as a specialized active-participle aftermath word make that emptiness the last residue.

topics.headline: final adjective seals the palm image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hollowness is grammatically locked onto the palm-remnant image as the final descriptive word.
topics.reason: Attachment reads the adjective as modifying the genitive palm noun, while CRITICAL rows also preserve semantic application to the trunk-remnants.

topics.headline: active participle as continuing hollowness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hollowness as a settled condition, not a momentary event.
topics.reason: The active participle form names a state characterizing the remains.

topics.headline: ruin vocabulary narrowed to hollow interiors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wider ruin vocabulary is narrowed by the palm context to hollow interiors, while collapsed-structure overtones remain audible.
topics.reason: The root can describe collapsed or emptied structures, but the local palm phrase selects internal hollowness.

topics.headline: void interior after human comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the simile ends not merely with trunks but with evacuated interior life.
topics.reason: The root-image of emptiness is applied to the palm-trunk comparison after humans have been mapped onto it.

topics.headline: ayah closes on emptied shell
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing on internal emptiness, framed against the opening imposed force.

baseline_models.mechanism: Purpose-bound subjection and an exact night/day count make the wind a scheduled operation. The two faces of time and the unbroken-succession branch of حسوما close off pauses: the force remains on task across the whole interval.

activation_trace.role: Purpose-bound subjection makes the wind an instrument assigned to a specific end.
The numerical branch fixes one edge of the operation at seven nights.
Night and its darkness supply the operation's nocturnal face rather than an incidental time label.
Eight supplies the offset daytime count that completes the stated temporal envelope.
The span-of-time branch lets the days function as measured duration, not only daylight units.
Unbroken succession removes any recovery interval and turns the count into continuous exposure.

changed_reading.before: A destructive wind happened to last seven nights and eight days.
changed_reading.after: The wind is a commissioned process whose exact duration and uninterrupted execution belong to its destructive mechanism.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: القوم صرعى كأنهم أعجاز نخل خاوية.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse reverses a standing human collective into cast-down vegetal structure. قوم activates bodily uprightness, صرعى supplies the throw to earth, أعجاز relocates identity to rear or residual bases, and خاوية completes both collapse and loss of support.

activation_trace.role: Upright bodily standing supplies the initial posture that the scene violently reverses.
Casting down to the ground performs the central vertical reversal.
The rear or hind-part branch reduces once-whole figures to residual bases or trunk ends.
The date-palm branch supplies the tall organic support whose felling models the bodies.
Falling and structural collapse complete the conversion from standing people to failed trunks.

changed_reading.before: The dead merely resemble fallen palm trunks in shape.
changed_reading.after: The simile stages a structural reversal: an upright collective is thrown down and reduced to failed bases, so posture and social solidity are destroyed together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فترى and the detailed corpse-to-palm comparison.
baseline_models.mechanism: The second-person act of seeing turns the aftermath into an exhibited result. The chain from people to fallen material to vacant palms is arranged for inspection, making the simile evidentiary rather than merely ornamental.

activation_trace.role: Eye-seeing positions the addressee as an inspector of a visible result.
Making something seen gives the scene the function of disclosure, not passive scenery.
The human collective is the identifiable subject whose condition is publicly displayed.
The fallen or dried branch image bridges bodies and inspectable storm debris.
Vacancy makes the displayed remains testify to the absence of their former occupants or life.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports what the victims looked like after the storm.
changed_reading.after: The verse deliberately exhibits a legible afterimage: the visible bodies are evidence from which the addressee is made to infer emptied life and destroyed collective form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding verse identifies the subjected agent as a cold wind whose branch field includes force and dominance, while عتو supplies refusal of ordinary obedience. Read back into سخرها, the paradox is hierarchical: a force that exceeds creaturely limits is itself exactly governed and aimed.

activation_trace.role: Purpose-bound command provides the higher control under which the excessive force operates.
Unbroken succession shows that control maintains rather than dampens the wind's operation.
Falling into annihilation supplies the explicitly stated endpoint of the wind's task.
Wind as force and dominance supplies the agent's overpowering capacity.
The cold-wind branch gives the commanded force a physically punishing medium.
Refusal of obedience supplies the force's apparent limitlessness, which higher subjection contains.

structural_cues: 69:6 immediately supplies the antecedent of سخرها and stacks destruction, wind, coldness, and عاتية before the focus gives duration and result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cold, overpowering, disobedience-coded wind and its annihilating result; I infer that سخر reverses its apparent autonomy into exact higher service. A live alternative is that عاتية only intensifies the storm and contributes no hierarchy beyond the explicit subjection.

changed_reading.before: Subjection means that an otherwise ordinary wind is used as a tool.
changed_reading.after: Subjection governs a force defined by excess: its wildness toward the victims and its obedience to the assigning power coexist rather than cancel each other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse repeats seeing but converts it into a question about any remainder. That revision distinguishes visible residue from living or enduring continuity: the bodies can fill the field of vision while counting as no بَاقِيَة at all.

activation_trace.role: Eye-seeing supplies the initial inspection of the bodies.
Vacancy makes the visible forms present while their sustaining life is absent.
Repeated seeing turns the prior tableau into the evidence searched for by the question.
The branch of what remains sets the criterion the visible corpses fail: they preserve no viable remainder.

structural_cues: 69:8 follows without a scene change and repeats ترى inside a yes-or-no search for any باقية.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible fallen forms followed by a visual test for remainder; I infer that corpse-residue is being contrasted with continuance. A live alternative is that 69:8 simply restates total death without distinguishing kinds of remainder.

changed_reading.before: The corpses are the remains left by the storm.
changed_reading.after: The corpses are paradoxical anti-remains: visually present debris that proves no human continuity remained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later flood sequence contrasts being carried in a vessel with making an event a reminder held by a receptive ear. Read back into فترى, the ruined bodies become a negative vessel: their palm-like forms hold and transmit the memory of what cannot carry life forward.

activation_trace.role: Making seen lets the ruined scene function as a deliberately presented mnemonic object.
The durable palm form gives the memory a concrete visual carrier.
Collapse marks this carrier as wreckage rather than a vessel of survival.
Bearing a visible load supplies the contrasting mechanism of preservation through catastrophe.
A reminder explicitly assigns past catastrophe a future memory function.
Containing something in a vessel supplies the storage model for receiving the exhibited scene.
Attentive acceptance identifies the human receiver that turns catastrophe into retained warning.

structural_cues: 69:11-12 moves from a vessel that carries survivors to an event made into a reminder and contained by a receptive ear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical carrying, mnemonic making, and receptive containment; I infer that the focus tableau is a negative memorial whose empty forms carry warning instead of life. A live alternative is that only the flood episode, not the wind scene, receives the explicit memorial function.

changed_reading.before: The palm-trunk image records destruction vividly.
changed_reading.after: The image also operates as a negative ark: emptied forms carry the event into memory even though they carried no people through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence collapses mountains, makes the event fall, weakens the sky, and then exposes everyone. It scales up the focus's bodily geometry: upright supports fail, elevated mass is leveled, and the resulting condition is presented for inspection.

activation_trace.role: Human uprightness supplies the small-scale support whose failure begins the analogy.
Casting down gives the focus scene the same downward vector as the later cosmic event.
Collapse turns the bodies and palms into a local model of failed structure.
Elevated solid mass supplies the larger support structure subjected to failure.
Pounding and leveling generalize the focus's felling from bodies and trees to terrain.
Falling and becoming fixed turns downward motion into an accomplished event-state.
Weakening supplies the failure of the highest enclosing structure after lower supports fall.
Exhibiting something for view extends the focus's visual inspection to universal presentation.

structural_cues: 69:13-18 progresses from one blast through leveled earth and mountains, a weakened sky, and universal exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated support failure, downward leveling, and later exhibition; I infer a scale relation in which the felled people are a material rehearsal of cosmic collapse. A live alternative is that the scenes share catastrophe vocabulary without the focus serving as a model of the later one.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives a historically bounded scene of bodies felled by wind.
changed_reading.after: The bodies form a small-scale diagram of a wider collapse grammar: standing supports fail, worlds are leveled, and the result is exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's seven/eight duration joins later exact allocations: eight bearers and a chain measured at seventy cubits. This recurrence lets number function as calibration of force, burden, and duration rather than decorative precision.

activation_trace.role: Seven begins the exact calibration of the wind's temporal load.
Eight completes the focus count and creates a number later reused for assigned bearing.
A measured span of time supplies the first dimension being calibrated.
Unbroken succession makes the measured interval operational rather than merely chronological.
The repeated eight assigns an exact number to a later load-bearing arrangement.
Connected chain links provide the later instrument whose extent is explicitly measured.
Measurement by cubit makes calibrated extent explicit rather than inferred.
The numerical branch expands seven into seventy within another precisely dimensioned punishment.

structural_cues: The sequence repeats eight at 69:17 and expands seven to seventy inside the measured chain at 69:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurring numbers attached to duration, bearing, and chain length; I infer a shared logic of assigned measure and capacity. A live alternative is ordinary numerical coincidence with no mechanism linking the three scenes.

changed_reading.before: Seven nights and eight days provide historical duration.
changed_reading.after: The count can also mark calibrated administration: the destructive force is allotted a duration as exactly as later forces and burdens are allotted bearers and length.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later image of severing the life artery sharpens the cutting branch of حسوما. With the victims already rendered as palm rears and collapsed trunks, annihilation becomes loss of the connection by which organism and collective continue, not only accumulated impact.

activation_trace.role: Decisive cutting supplies a severance mechanism already latent in the focus description.
Extirpation turns severance into removal of the group's capacity to continue.
Residual hind parts or bases give the severing mechanism a visible remainder.
Palm trunks materialize the organic body whose continuity has been cut.
Collapse displays the structural consequence of losing the vital connection.
Severing and separation supplies the directional action that sharpens حسوما.
The life-artery image identifies what kind of connection makes cutting terminal.

structural_cues: 69:46 gives an explicit cut-plus-life-line construction; 69:7 gives cut-off duration and bodies resembling residual trunks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decisive cutting in the focus and later severing of a life artery; I infer that the palm-body field visualizes severed continuity at both bodily and communal scales. A live alternative is that the two cuts only share a terminal endpoint and should not be treated as one material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: حسوما says that the prolonged wind annihilated the people.
changed_reading.after: The wind's annihilation is legible as vital severance: it cuts the sustaining continuity and leaves only collapsed organic bases.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later branches of interposing barrier and protective ward activate the focus's geometry. سخرها عليهم places the force against or over them, while حسوما keeps it continuous; no gap, shield, or mediator interrupts the assigned contact.

activation_trace.role: Purpose-bound directing supplies the vector that places the force onto its target.
Unbroken succession means no temporal barrier interrupts exposure.
Interposition by a separator supplies the absent spatial mechanism that could have broken contact.
Warding off harm by protection supplies the absent defensive mechanism.

structural_cues: The focus preposition عليهم gives directed contact; later 69:47-48 places barrier and protection language side by side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed subjection, continuity, interposition, and warding; I infer that the victims' exposure is total because neither spatial separation nor protection breaks the wind's contact. A live alternative is that the later barrier and protection language belongs only to the revelation passage and does not reactivate the storm's geometry.

changed_reading.before: The wind blows upon the people continuously.
changed_reading.after: عليهم becomes a geometry of unshielded contact: the assigned force reaches them without temporal pause, spatial separator, or effective protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pairing of what is seen and unseen, followed by reality and certainty, enlarges فترى from optical report into evidentiary training. The visible ruined bodies become the inspectable half of a claim whose reach exceeds sight.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye supplies the concrete evidence from which the larger judgment begins.
Reflective judgment lets vision become inference rather than remain a retinal report.
Eye-sight explicitly marks the visible domain to which the focus aftermath belongs.
Heart-insight supplies a mode for carrying the visible evidence toward what vision alone does not contain.
Reality matching fact gives the inspected aftermath an epistemic endpoint opposed to denial.
Settled knowledge without doubt names the certainty toward which the exhibited scene presses.

structural_cues: 69:38-39 deliberately pairs the visible and invisible, and 69:51 closes with حق اليقين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus imperative-like address to see, a later visible/invisible pair, and certainty language; I infer that the corpse tableau trains inference from manifest effect to a reality beyond immediate sight. A live alternative is that فترى remains only vivid narration while the epistemic frame begins much later.

changed_reading.before: You are asked to picture a visible historical aftermath.
changed_reading.after: You are made to inspect a visible effect as evidence: sight is the first step in a judgment that the later visible/unseen and certainty frame completes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ر و ي mapping under focus ترى rather than its ordinary seeing root. It remains valid as a mapped split-root resonance and is sharpened by the immediate question about any remainder; downstream prose must call it a form-distant activation, never a lexical gloss of ترى.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because نخل is plainly the palm in the simile, while the sifting branch is form-distant. It remains anchored in that exact focus root and coheres with a whole people cast down and no remainder; downstream prose should present a secondary sieve-image activated by the noun, not replace the palm translation with sifting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's نخل root inside a commanded process that casts down the whole قوم.

changed_reading.before: The wind leaves people lying like palm trunks.
changed_reading.after: A secondary branch-image makes the prolonged wind act like a sieve upon the collective, depositing felled forms while allowing no viable human remainder through.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from the material vacancy of خاوية to form-distant uncovering branches under حسرة and covering branches under كفر. It remains anchored in the hollow human-palm forms and packet-local concealment vocabulary; downstream prose must qualify it as a moral-material reversal, not derive the ordinary meanings of حسرة or كفر from those remote images.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's visibly vacant human-palm shells.

activation_trace.role: Vacancy turns the bodies into present exteriors emptied of what they once enclosed.
Hollowness of the belly materializes inward depletion within the palm-body image.
Removal of a covering activates exposure as the reversal imposed on the emptied forms.
Being bare of protection joins physical exposure to the failure of shelter.
Covering supplies the action materially reversed by visible emptiness and exposure.
Concealing truth supplies the moral domain that the exposed corpse-field reverses.

changed_reading.before: The hollow trunks convey physical death and collapse.
changed_reading.after: As a contained cross-domain activation, the hollow trunks become exposed coverings: concealment ends in an exterior made visible precisely because its sustaining interior and protection are gone.

strongest_changes: The counted storm changed from a long event into a purpose-bound, uninterrupted operation.
The palm simile changed from visual resemblance into a reversal of upright bodily and collective support.
The repeated seeing and remainder question changed visible corpses into anti-remains that prove extinction rather than continuity.
Later cut-life-line and barrier vocabulary sharpened the mechanism as vital severance under unshielded contact.
Cosmic collapse and exact later measures kept material-scale and calibrated-administration readings alive beside the historical scene.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports simultaneous temporal and cutting senses of حسوما, while قوم/صرعى/أعجاز/نخل/خاوية creates a dense standing-to-collapse mechanism. Context then changes the same tableau into a remnant test, negative memorial, scale model, and evidentiary display; split-root and remote branch images add residue, sieve, and exposed-covering outliers without displacing the ordinary reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The succession, decisive-cutting, and extirpation branches of حسوما may be deliberately cumulative or only neighboring lexical affordances.
The recurrence of seven, eight, and measured seventy may encode calibrated assignment or may be ordinary scene-specific counting.
The split-root residue, palm-sieve, and exposed-covering readings are packet-licensed activations but must not be promoted into lexical translations.
خاوية can keep vacancy, bodily hollowness, and structural collapse live together; the focus alone does not force one image to exclude the others.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Commanded duration as decisive excision.** **س خ ر B001** (bringing a thing under command for a purpose) and **ح س م B001** (decisive cutting off) make the counted nights and days functional rather than decorative. The packet supplies imposed service, duration, and the absence of a remnant in 69:8; I infer that the wind is kept at work until the community is cut off. The ayah reads as a calibrated operation with an extinction condition.
2. **Standing social form reduced to fallen material.** **ص ر ع B001** (casting down and falling to the ground) is juxtaposed with the palm-trunk simile and then `باقية` in 69:8. The packet supplies fall, hollow trunks, and residue-testing sight; I infer that communal agency has been converted into inspectable debris. `فترى` therefore initiates an evidentiary survey, not only a vivid scene.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:32's measured chain unexpectedly echoes this measured destructive duration; both punishments read as calibrated operations rather than unbounded chaos.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The standing collective is converted into the fallen collective.** `ق و م` B001 denotes a group, but B002 is "upright standing and bodily rising"; `ص ر ع` B001 is "casting down and falling to the ground." Their immediate predicative contact, `ٱلْقَوْمَ ... صَرْعَىٰ`, activates a posture reversal inside the ordinary group noun. B002's role is the lost vertical state and `ص ر ع` B001 the forceful result. The packet supplies standing-root/group followed by fallen bodies; I infer the conversion upright -> prone. The scene reads as the systematic un-standing of a people, not merely a report that many died.
2. **Persons become fallen timber.** `ص ر ع` B007 is "a fallen or dried branch used as material"; `ع ج ز` B004 is "the rear or hind part of a thing"; `ن خ ل` B001 is the date palm. The simile immediately turns the human `صَرْعَىٰ` into palm rears/trunks. B007 assigns the bodies the role of detached material, while B004 selects the leftover base rather than a living crown. The packet gives the simile; I infer that deanimation is its causal work: people -> unusable or discarded timber. The reading changes from visual resemblance to a material demotion of social bodies.
3. **Continuous duration is measured by terminal cutting.** `ح س م` B001 is "decisive cutting off." It modifies the exact seven-night/eight-day span and is followed by the absence of a `بَاقِيَةٍ` in 69:8. The branch makes each temporal unit part of a sustained severing process whose criterion is no residue. The packet gives duration and no remainder; I infer that continuity of force enables completeness of severance. `حُسُومًۭا` thus reads causally: the days are consecutive because the work of cutting off is carried through to its endpoint.
4. **Hollowness and collapse remain distinct.** `خ و ي` B001 is "vacancy and empty space," while B002 is "falling and collapse." The fallen posture and hollow-palm comparison visibly support both branches. Vacancy assigns the corpses an emptied interior; collapse assigns them a failed structure. The packet supplies both images but not a causal order; I infer that internal emptying and external toppling jointly explain the simile. `خَاوِيَةٍ` therefore retains two mechanisms rather than collapsing into a generic adjective of ruin.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:17 unexpectedly repeats eight, now as throne-carriers rather than days, and 69:32 expands seven into seventy for the chain. These later measures make the fixed seven/eight span part of a broader pattern in which force is precisely counted, whether destructive, supportive, or restraining. This strengthens `ح س م` B001: the storm is not vague chaos but a measured process carried to decisive completion.

baseline.text: Onu yedi gece ve sekiz gün boyunca kesintisiz olarak üzerlerine saldı. Böylece halkı onun içinde yere serilmiş görürsün; sanki onlar içi boş hurma kütükleridir.

findings.text: Emir altındaki rüzgârın sayılı süre boyunca çalışması, topluluk bütünüyle kesilip bitene dek sürdürülen ölçülü bir yok etme işlemi kurar.
Ayakta duran topluluk fikri, yere serilme köküyle yan yana gelince halkın topluca dik durumdan düşürülmesini görünür kılar.
İnsan bedenleri, hurma gövdelerinin artıkları gibi işe yaramaz, kopmuş malzemeye indirgenir; benzetme yalnız görünüşü değil toplumsal öznenin cansızlaştırılmasını anlatır.
Görme buyruğu, yıkıntıyı yalnız tasvir etmek yerine, topluluğun bütünüyle sona erdiğini denetleyen bir kanıt incelemesine çevirir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Binding truth becomes inspectable
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What is real acquires force by being fixed, owed, demonstrated, and finally exposed to view.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same lexical field materializes truth as an owned claim, a protected obligation, a fitted joint, a penetrating thrust, and a textile whose weave can be tested.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Display, inspection, and removal of concealment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Observers face a scene, inspect its visible marks, and have what was covered brought out.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: رؤية العين والبصيرة (`quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`); رأي القلب والتفكر (`quranic:root_000531:B002/m01`); الرؤيا في المنام (`quranic:root_000531:B003/m01`); تراء وتواجه (`quranic:root_000531:B004/m01`); مرأى ومنظر ومرآة (`quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`); إراءة وإظهار (`quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`); أرأيتك للتنبيه والاستخبار (`quranic:root_000531:B013/m01`); الستر والخفاء (`quranic:root_000428:B001/m01`); إزالة الخفاء والإظهار (`quranic:root_000428:B003/m01`); لمع البرق الخفي (`quranic:root_000428:B004/m01`); عرض الشيء وإبرازه للنظر (`quranic:root_001001:B002/m01`); العارض البادي من جهة (`quranic:root_001001:B003/m01`); معاريض الكلام وجه غير مصرح به (`quranic:root_001001:B010/m01`); الدراية والعلم (`quranic:root_000473:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Eye, inward judgment, dream, mutual facing, mirror-image, induced showing, and the interrogative call to report all organize modes of inspection. Concealment is removed rather than merely denied: a faint flash emerges from cloud, an object is displayed, and even indirect wording has an outer and inner face to be read.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Defiance meets coercive mastery
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Exceeded limits, refused obedience, and imposed service are answered by a force that masters agents and elements.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Transgression shifts between moral rebellion, physical overflow, tyrannical rule, forced labor, and the smooth elevated rock on which resistance finds no purchase.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Limit-breaking rebellion and tyrannical command
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Agents leave obedience, harden into domination, and organize others around a head of error.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: مجاوزة الحد في العصيان (`quranic:root_000936:B001/m01`); الطاغوت رأس الضلالة والطغيان (`quranic:root_000936:B003/m01`); الطاغية المتجبر (`quranic:root_000936:B004/m01`); مجاوزة الحد في العصيان (`quranic:root_000937:B001/m01`); الطاغوت رأس الضلالة (`quranic:root_000937:B003/m01`); العُتُوّ عن الطاعة (`quranic:root_000981:B001/m01`); الخروج عن الطاعة (`quranic:root_001022:B001/m01`); تسخير العامل بلا أجرة (`quranic:root_000685:B002/m01`); عزم ونهوض إلى الأمر (`quranic:root_001273:B003/m01`); رعاية وحفظ وولاية (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); عسر ومنع (`quranic:root_000217:B009/m01`); حمل على أمر (`quranic:root_000217:B010/m01`); كذب عليك بمعنى الزم وعليك به (`quranic:root_001290:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `ط غ و`: unavailable (surface root missing); `ط غ ي`: 69:5 (طَّاغِيَةِ), 69:11 (طَغَا); `ع ت و`: 69:6 (عَاتِيَةٍ); `ع ص ي`: 69:10 (عَصَ); `س خ ر`: 69:7 (سَخَّرَ); `ق و م`: 69:7 (قَوْمَ); `ج ب ل`: 69:14 (جِبَالُ); `ك ذ ب`: 69:4 (كَذَّبَتْ)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Moral excess becomes a hierarchy: rebellion crosses a limit, a tyrant or false cultic head directs it, and pride refuses command. Forced labor, obstructive difficulty, compulsion, and an imperative of obligation supply the coercive underside, while resolve and governance show the same capacity turned toward taking charge of an undertaking.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Impact becomes capture and defeat
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A blow is followed through its full sequence: collision, opposed force, gripping control, collapse, and exhausted aftermath.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sequence reaches from knocking at a door and the clang of iron to wrestling holds, battlefield lines, uprooted bodies, and a road that consumes its traveler.

Wrestling grips and mutual resistance convert sound into control, while the truth or failure of a charge is tested by whether it carries through to thrust and strike.

The target's lack of capacity to face the force closes the mechanism: there is a grip and no adequate counter-grip.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hollow trunk, uprooting, and emptied interior
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A standing organic form loses root, contents, and usable strength before falling.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: الخلو والفراغ (`quranic:root_000450:B001/m01`); السقوط والانهدام (`quranic:root_000450:B002/m01`); التجافي والتخوية (`quranic:root_000450:B004/m01`); خواء الجوف (`quranic:root_000450:B005/m01`); مؤخر الشيء وعقبه (`quranic:root_000985:B004/m01`); رملة أو حبل مرتفع يشبه العجيزة (`quranic:root_000985:B005/m01`); شجرة النخل (`quranic:root_001483:B001/m01`); غصن ساقط أو يابس يتخذ منه (`quranic:root_000859:B007/m01`); قطع حاسم (`quranic:root_000322:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Vacancy, collapse, a gap between surfaces, and an empty belly converge on the palm-trunk image. The rear or lower part and a raised sand form preserve its contour, while fallen dry wood and decisive cutting explain how vertical continuity is lost; lack of inner reason or value supplies the human analogue.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mountain mass reduced to low ground
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Raised, hard terrain is struck, spread, crowded, and brought level with the ground.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: السفل المقابل للسماء (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); لزوم الأرض والتثاقل إليها (`quranic:root_000025:B006/m01`); الأَرْض الرعدة (`quranic:root_000025:B008/m01`); تجمع مرتفع صلب (`quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`); صلابة توقف الحفر (`quranic:root_000217:B005/m01`); دخول الجبال (`quranic:root_000217:B006/m01`); مصادفة رمل عريض (`quranic:root_000217:B011/m01`); الدق والهدم حتى التسوية (`quranic:root_000482:B001/m01`); الانبساط والانخفاض (`quranic:root_000482:B002/m01`); التزاحم والتراكم (`quranic:root_000482:B008/m01`); رملة أو حبل مرتفع يشبه العجيزة (`quranic:root_000985:B005/m01`); فرجة بين الرمال ونباتها (`quranic:root_000807:B007/m01`); أرض مرتفعة (`quranic:root_000537:B002/m01`); المكان المرتفع والسحاب الواقع (`quranic:root_001675:B016/m01`); الطغية الصفاة أو الموضع المرتفع (`quranic:root_000936:B006/m01`); الطغية نبذة من الشيء (`quranic:root_000936:B007/m01`); الطغية الصفاة الملساء (`quranic:root_000937:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `ء ر ض`: 69:14 (أَرْضُ); `ج ب ل`: 69:14 (جِبَالُ); `د ك ك`: 69:14 (دُكَّ/دَكَّةً); `ع ج ز`: 69:7 (أَعْجَازُ); `ش ق ق`: 69:16 (ٱنشَقَّتِ); `ر ب و`: 69:10 (رَّابِيَةً); `و ق ع`: 69:15 (وَقَعَتِ/وَاقِعَةُ); `ط غ و`: unavailable (surface root missing); `ط غ ي`: 69:5 (طَّاغِيَةِ), 69:11 (طَغَا)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Earth is the lower plane against which mountain, broad sand ridge, elevated patch, lesser height, smooth high rock, and detached fragment are measured. Hardness first stops the digger; then pounding, spreading, trembling, and massing erase that resistance, leaving gaps and low continuous terrain where distinct heights had stood. The `ط غ و` rock and fragment motifs have no available surface-root anchor.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rain misses or withdraws, growth fails, and place becomes empty, exposed, and lethal to a traveler.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: أرض مأفوكة صرف عنها المطر (`quranic:root_000041:B005/m01`); أرض أخطأها المطر (`quranic:root_000420:B003/m01`); أرض هلكين لا غيث فيها (`quranic:root_001596:B005/m01`); مهواة ومفازة مهلكة (`quranic:root_001596:B006/m01`); إخلاف النوء (`quranic:root_000450:B003/m01`); خواء الجوف (`quranic:root_000450:B005/m01`); قرع وانكشاف وخلو (`quranic:root_001219:B008/m01`); دوام الشيء وبقاؤه (`quranic:root_000142:B001/m01`); البقية وما يبقى من الشيء (`quranic:root_000142:B002/m01`); الإبقاء عفوا واستحياء (`quranic:root_000142:B003/m01`); حبس بعض الشيء وادخاره (`quranic:root_000142:B004/m01`); يبس الشجر (`quranic:root_000217:B008/m01`); ما بالدار نافخ ضرمة (`quranic:root_001529:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: A rainless, burned tract and a star-season that yields no water lead to hollow bellies, dead wood, stripped enclosures, an empty house, and a killing waste. Against that extinction, remaining, remnant, mercy, and saved reserve become sharply material counter-images: survival is what has not been stripped out of the place.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Flood becomes conveyance and controlled water
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water moves from excess to transport, capture, storage, and measured delivery.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The flood scene opens into hydraulic engineering: channels, catch basins, wells, receiving hands, cloud-reservoirs, and reflective coatings.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Watered sheen, plating, and reflected appearance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A thin liquid-like surface changes how metal, face, fruit, or stone appears to an observer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: كسوة المعدن بماء الذهب أو الفضة (`quranic:root_001458:B005/m01`); رونق كالماء في الوجه والكلام والثمر (`quranic:root_001458:B006/m01`); صفاء الماوية كالبلور والمرآة (`quranic:root_001458:B007/m01`); مرأى ومنظر ومرآة (`quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`); لمع البرق الخفي (`quranic:root_000428:B004/m01`); الصورة والهيئة المصورة (`quranic:root_000891:B003/m01`); العارض البادي من جهة (`quranic:root_001001:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Metal plating can disguise its substrate, while watery brightness gives face, speech, fruit, crystal, and mirror their sheen. Reflection, faint lightning, formed image, and a distant appearing mass make appearance a surface event whose truth depends on what lies beneath.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: A message is sent, heard, and kept
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Communication is a custody chain in which a charge is dispatched, carried, received, retained, and made recallable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The communication chain is materialized as herd after herd, flowing provision, a carried burden, an inward vessel, a legal deed, and an ear that acts as a gate of permission.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Spoken name, reputation, and public recurrence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Repeated speech makes a person or event present in communal memory as name, fame, praise, or blame.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: جريان الذكر على اللسان (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`); ذكر المرء شرف وصيت (`quranic:root_000516:B007/m01`); الاسم تنويه ودلالة (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`); الصيت الحسن المنتشر (`quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`); رياء الناس (`quranic:root_000531:B005/m01`); الرسول والرسالة (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); استقامة واعتدال واستواء (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`); ردع يقرع السامع (`quranic:root_001219:B006/m01`); الجَعْلة اسم مكان (`quranic:root_000248:B011/m01`); العلم بموضع أو يوم (`quranic:root_000450:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Tongued mention and carried message give a name public reach; favorable renown can rise, while place-name and named day stabilize reference. Performance for spectators and rebuke expose distorted social uses of visibility, and straight speech supplies the norm by which praise, blame, and reputation are heard.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Falsehood redirects signs and surfaces
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Misrepresentation works by attributing what is not so, coating reality with a misleading surface, or turning perception away from its proper object.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Falsehood reaches bodily motion and materials: milk promises continuity then stops, an animal runs then checks, cloth lies by its colors, metal is plated, and a charm turns a face.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: False report, attribution, and inward self-deception
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A speaker or community asserts what is contrary to fact, assigns the lie to another, or houses deception in the self.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: خلاف الصدق (`quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`); نسبة الشيء أو صاحبه إلى الكذب (`quranic:root_001290:B002/m01`); النفس الكذوب (`quranic:root_001290:B008/m01`); الإفك كذب مصروف عن الصدق (`quranic:root_000041:B002/m01`); عقل مأفوك وحيلة مصروفة (`quranic:root_000041:B006/m01`); ردع يقرع السامع (`quranic:root_001219:B006/m01`); رياء الناس (`quranic:root_000531:B005/m01`); الوقيعة في الناس (`quranic:root_001675:B013/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Lie, accusation of lying, deceptive self, turned judgment, and backbiting form a single testimonial failure. Public performance seeks witnesses rather than truth, while rebuke presses the hearer to reverse direction and re-enter truthful judgment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A fabricated outer appearance induces an observer or target to take one thing for another.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: الكذابة ثوب يكذب بحاله (`quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`); كسوة المعدن بماء الذهب أو الفضة (`quranic:root_001458:B005/m01`); خرزة تقبل وجها إلى وجه (`quranic:root_001198:B016/m01`); رقية تمسك وتحبس (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); مرأى ومنظر ومرآة (`quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`); رئي من الجن (`quranic:root_000531:B008/m01`); الصورة والهيئة المصورة (`quranic:root_000891:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Multicolored cloth 'lies' by its state, plating presents base metal as precious, and a bead or binding charm turns attention and action. Mirror-image and a presenting spirit supply receivers for that manufactured appearance; formed shape can be mentally real while materially misleading.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Promised continuation that abruptly fails
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An action appears likely to persist but stops, delays, or proves unable to complete its course.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Immediate action can belie delay, milk can belie expected duration, and a running animal can halt to look back. Speechlessness, incapacity, escape, and a stalled mount turn failed continuation into a bodily scene; watchful waiting measures the gap between expectation and arrival.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Sovereignty rests on raised supports
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Rule is sustained by a hierarchy of throne, upper position, structural mainstay, delegated care, and communal covenant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Royal elevation is tested through architecture and husbandry: a throne may be broken, a roof propped, a well timbered, a flock led, and a polity maintained by water and covenant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: King, throne, and superior position
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A sovereign occupies a raised seat and exercises rule through rank, power, and recognized leadership.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ربوبية وملك وسيادة (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); علم رباني (`quranic:root_000532:B003/m01`); رباني الملاحين (`quranic:root_000532:B017/m01`); المِلْك والتصرف (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`); المُلك والسلطان (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); مِلاك الأمر وعِماده (`quranic:root_001444:B005/m01`); المتقدم القائد في الحيوان (`quranic:root_001444:B008/m01`); السرير المرتفع للملك (`quranic:root_001000:B001/m01`); قوام الأمر والعز إذا ثبت أو ثل (`quranic:root_001000:B006/m01`); علو المنزلة والفضل (`quranic:root_001188:B002/m01`); علو القهر والغلبة (`quranic:root_001188:B003/m01`); رعاية وحفظ وولاية (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); قوام وعماد ومعاش (`quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`); سادات كالجِبال (`quranic:root_000217:B012/m01`); مقروع مختار وخيار (`quranic:root_001219:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Lordship, learned divine formation, captaincy, ownership, kingship, and the affair's mainstay converge on the raised throne. Superior rank and coercive power explain the vertical relation, while recognized leaders and chosen chiefs translate it into the governed community; a 'broken throne' names the collapse of the whole arrangement.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Roof, vine-trellis, well frame, litter, mounted animal, and stable emplacement share the operation of bearing above a lower base. channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A responsible agent maintains dependents, property, and resources until they reach a sound state.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Gradual upbringing, care for a stepchild, settled attendance, and a ewe kept near the house show rule as maintenance. Coherence, mainstay, water supply, substitution, guarantee, care for an unverified dependent, and merciful preservation all ask whether authority keeps what has been entrusted to it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Groups become a polity through assembly, recognized divisions, and a covenant that holds them together.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Large gatherings, lots held in one container, herds, councils, tribes, and crowds are not yet a polity until a pledge and guarantor bind their divisions. Place of assembly and sheer multitude provide the social material; covenant supplies the relation that makes it durable.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Herd life follows generation, movement, and equipment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Animal life is organized through mating, gestation, maturation, herd circulation, milking intervals, shelter, and predation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The lexical network turns abstract completion and return into a full pastoral economy, from conception and birth through age, watering, tack, shelter, and the hunter's blind.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mating, conception, and approaching birth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Male and female animals meet, conception becomes visible, and a carried young approaches emergence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Breeding readiness, mounting, deposited seed, visible pregnancy, inward burden, swelling, menstrual sign, and the nearness of birth form a continuous generational scene. A stallion rising over mares and bodily weight in intercourse make coupling explicit; young camel, lamb, ostrich chick, and wild-cattle calf mark successive products. The `ط غ و` calf motif has no available surface-root anchor.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Old camel, late child, extreme age, thick bodily formation, inherited disposition, stature, breadth of foot, Bactrian camel, completed fatness, and matched stride describe maturity as a change in usable form. channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Tree and grove provide the direct image, but the palm is also reproduced as ornament, forelock-like form, short planting, and toponym. Uprooting reverses this multiplication, and the persistent green plant preserves the living form against the scene of collapse.

pericope.label: The inevitable event and ruined peoples

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeyi bir buyruk ya da istenen sonuç doğrultusunda boyun eğdirme, yöneltme ve elverişli kılma çekirdeğinde birleşir. Bir kimse için kolaylaştırma ile geminin söz dinleyip rahat yol alması, bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir; bunlar alay etme ya da ücretsiz çalıştırma anlamını bu dala katmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, amaçlı boyun eğdirme ve elverişli kılmayla sınırlıdır; karşılıksız emek ve alay ayrı dallarda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, eylem adlarındaki genel çekirdeği korur; bir kimse için kolaylaştırma ve geminin söz dinlemesi gibi kuruluşlara bağlı kullanımları ayrıca sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bir buyruğa veya istenen işe boyun eğdirerek o işe yöneltmek ve elverişli kılmaktır. Bir kimse için kolaylaştırma ile geminin söz dinleyip rahat yol alması bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Bir şey, kimi zaman zor kullanılarak, belirli bir işe boyun eğdirilir ve istenen sonuca doğru yöneltilir.
Boyun eğdirme çekirdeği, bir şeyi bir kimsenin yararlanmasına elverişli ve kolay duruma getirmeyi de kapsar.
Gemiye bağlı kullanımda geminin söz dinlemesi, gidişinin rahatlaması ve rüzgarın ona uygun olması anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyi buyruğa veya belirli bir işe boyun eğdirip yöneltme konusunda birleşir. Toplu anlatım ayrıca bir kimse için kolaylaştırmayı ve geminin uygun rüzgarla söz dinleyerek rahat ilerlemesini bu çekirdeğin bağlı görünümleri olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi istenen işe boyun eğdirip yöneltme
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın bütün çekirdeği için kullanılır; amaçlı yöneltmeyi ve denetim altına almayı birlikte taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Boyun eğdirilen bir şeyi istenen işe yöneltme çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin bir kimsenin denetimine ve yararlanmasına hazır kılındığı bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Denetime verme ve yararlanmaya hazır kılma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Her durumda belirli bir işe doğru yöneltmeyi ve gemiye bağlı söz dinleme görünümünü açıkça taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin bir kimse için elverişli duruma getirildiği kuruluşta kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kimse için elverişli ve kolay duruma getirme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Boyun eğdirme, denetim altına alma ve belirli işe yöneltme çekirdeğini tek başına vermez.

bir şeyi buyruğa boyun eğdirip biri için kolaylaştırmak
